"""Observe the original V156 controller, then validate, replay, score and render."""

import os
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261103/V156-local-risk-v1'
training=read(root/'plan-v1.json')
guard(training)
post=root/'postprocess-v1'
env=os.environ.copy()
env['PYTHONPATH']=':'.join(str(p) for p in [post/'scripts',Path(training['work'])/'scripts',Path(training['work'])/'src'])
env['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS']=env['OMP_NUM_THREADS']='1'
env['HF_HUB_OFFLINE']=env['TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE']='1'
env['CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG']=':4096:8'
# Import the actual dynamically selected metric modules before queuing work.
command='from pathlib import Path;from score_local_risk_trial import load_module;'
command+='r=Path("/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261103");'
command+='load_module(r/"collaborative-detail-v1/transfer-v1.py","errors");'
command+='load_module(r/"V144-V145-photo-supplement-v1/operator-v2.py","photos");'
command+='import audit_local_risk_trial,render_local_risk_trial,review_local_risk_trial;'
command+='print("PASS all actual dynamic metric/reviewer/renderer imports")'
preflight=subprocess.run([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c',command],cwd=repo,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
assert preflight.returncode==0,(preflight.stdout,preflight.stderr)
owner=read(root/'status-v1.json')['owner']
plan={
    'root':str(root),'training_plan':ref(root/'plan-v1.json'),
    'design':ref(root/'quality-design-v1.json'),'expected_training_owner':owner,
    'inputs':[ref(root/'plan-v1.json'),ref(root/'quality-design-v1.json')],
    'frozen_files':{str(p):ref(p)['sha256'] for p in post.rglob('*.py')},
    'controller':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'import_preflight':{'returncode':preflight.returncode,'stdout':preflight.stdout,'stderr':preflight.stderr},
    'scope':'No parent/DINO/noise/training calls here. Wait on exact original training PID/create-time;do not restart. Mandatory strict CPU validation of final states/26 Adam states/control trace/raw/EMA/Adam,then3288 actual head calls including1644 bit-exact archived control replays with no duplicate array writes. New local raw/EMA arrays split local/external.4686 metric rows/30 real rows unscored,independent audit,72 native figures/24 triplets;actual human native viewing remains required.'}
assert not (root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json').exists()
save(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json',plan)
(root/'postprocess-controller.claim').open('x').close()
status={'status':'waiting-for-original-training-owner',
        'owner':{'pid':os.getpid(),'created':psutil.Process().create_time()},'completed':{}}
save(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json',status)
while True:
    current=read(root/'status-v1.json')
    assert current['owner']==owner
    if current['status']=='completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review':
        assert set(current['completed'])=={'parity','smoke','train'}
        break
    assert current['status'] in ['running-declared-phase','waiting-for-headroom'],current
    p=psutil.Process(owner['pid'])
    assert abs(p.create_time()-owner['created'])<.01 and p.status() not in ['dead','zombie']
    time.sleep(10)
stages=[
    ('checkpoint-validation','review_local_risk_trial.py',['--validate-only']),
    ('review','review_local_risk_trial.py',[]),
    ('scores','score_local_risk_trial.py',[]),
    ('metric-audit','audit_local_risk_trial.py',[]),
    ('render','render_local_risk_trial.py',[])]
for stage,name,extra in stages:
    guard(training);guard(plan)
    with (root/('postprocess-'+stage+'-v1.log')).open('x') as log:
        child=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),str(post/'scripts'/name),str(root),*extra],cwd=repo,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        childowner={'pid':child.pid,'created':psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
        status.update(status='running-'+stage,stage=stage,child_owner=childowner)
        save(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json',status)
        code=child.wait()
    status['completed'][stage]={'owner':childowner,'returncode':code}
    if code:
        status['status']='failed-'+stage+'-preserve-evidence-no-restart'
        save(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json',status)
        raise RuntimeError(status['status'])
status['status']='completed-four-endpoint-audits-and-rendering-awaiting-actual-native-viewing'
save(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json',status)
print(status['status'],flush=True)
